purpose: private authored activity pilot; not learner-facing

activities.cueEnglish: Find which layer follows the roof deck in Rogelio's explanation.
activities.modelFrench: Rogelio : « D’abord vient le platelage, puis la sous-couche. »
activities.modelEnglish: Rogelio: First comes the deck, then the underlayment.

activities.cueEnglish: Without looking, name the ice and water shield in French.
activities.modelFrench: la membrane d’étanchéité contre la glace et l’eau

activities.cueEnglish: Listen and identify the ridge cap in French.
Type 'Am I making sense?' in French.
Check whether Kevin understands the explanation.
activities.modelFrench: Rogelio : « Est-ce que je suis clair ? »

activities.cueEnglish: Write Kevin's summary of the three main stages.
activities.modelFrench: Kevin : « Oui : d’abord la base, puis la protection contre l’eau et enfin la ventilation. »
activities.modelEnglish: Kevin: Yes, first the base, then the protection against water, and at the end the ventilation.

activities.cueEnglish: Find what Rogelio uses to show the joint pattern.
activities.modelFrench: Rogelio : « Regarde, je vais te montrer avec deux bardeaux. »
activities.modelEnglish: Rogelio: Look, I'll show you with two shingles.

activities.cueEnglish: Without looking, name the pattern in French.
Listen and identify the water path in French.
Type 'May I explain why?' in French.
Ask the homeowner whether you may explain the joint pattern.
activities.modelFrench: Rogelio : « Madame, puis-je vous expliquer pourquoi ? »
activities.modelEnglish: Rogelio: Ma'am, may I explain why?

activities.cueEnglish: Write where moisture may reach before a leak appears.
activities.modelFrench: Rogelio : « Avec le temps, l’humidité peut atteindre le bois et une fuite peut apparaître dans la maison. »
activities.modelEnglish: Rogelio: Over time, moisture may reach the wood and a leak may appear inside the house.

activities.cueEnglish: Find where the nailing zone appears on the shingle.
activities.modelFrench: Rogelio : « Regarde cette ligne sur le bardeau : c’est la zone de clouage. »
activities.modelEnglish: Rogelio: Look at this line on the shingle; this is the nailing zone.

activities.cueEnglish: Without looking, name an overdriven nail in French.
Listen and identify the air pressure in French.
Type 'Turn down the pressure.' in French.
Invite Don Ernesto to check the local nailing approach.
activities.modelFrench: Rogelio : « Monsieur Ernesto, ici nous clouons ainsi; vérifiez-le vous-même également, s’il vous plaît. »
activities.modelEnglish: Rogelio: Don Ernesto, here we nail like this; please check it yourself too.

activities.cueEnglish: Write how the nail head should sit.
activities.modelFrench: Rogelio : « Regarde bien la tête du clou; elle doit être à fleur, pas plus bas. »
activities.modelEnglish: Rogelio: Look closely at the nail head; it has to sit flush, not lower.
